SELECT t.vessel_id, SUM(jc.charge) AS total_established_charges
FROM tow_job t
JOIN job_charge jc ON jc.job_id = t.job_id
GROUP BY t.vessel_id
ORDER BY t.vessel_id
tasks.unresolved_handling: Only jobs with an established row in job_charge are included. Jobs J5, J6, and J7 have no job_charge tuple and are excluded from each vessel total rather than treated as zero.

SELECT job_id FROM tow_job WHERE berth = 'B12' ORDER BY job_id;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jc.charge), 0) AS total_established_charges
FROM tow_job t
JOIN job_charge jc ON jc.job_id = t.job_id
WHERE t.berth = 'B12';

SELECT t.job_id, bo.status, bo.reason
FROM tow_job t
LEFT JOIN job_charge jc ON jc.job_id = t.job_id
LEFT JOIN billing_outcome bo ON bo.job_id = t.job_id
WHERE t.berth = 'B12' AND jc.job_id IS NULL
ORDER BY t.job_id
tasks.unresolved_handling: Established charges sum only job_charge rows for B12 jobs (none exist, so total is 0). Jobs lacking a job_charge row are listed separately using billing_outcome, which records insufficient_evidence for both J5 and J7 due to after-hours B12 towing without emergency documentation.
